thread:
Nina: Hey design — request for a compact launch kit for Apr 22 webinar. Need: 1 hero infographic (wide), 4 social crops (X + LinkedIn + IG + story), 1 animated GIF (quick stat), and a one-page PDF benchmark summary for sales. Can you take this?
Owen: We can. Which single stat leads the narrative?
Nina: Lead with median (p50) latency 60ms, p99 160ms, cost $0.08/1k tokens, throughput 200 reqs/s on Dedicated. Messaging anchors: 'unified runtime', 'predictable economics', 'production-grade'.
Priya: For copy: keep hero <= 9 words. Social variants: short X copy and longer LinkedIn. Also need a one-line alt for each image.
Design-bot: New Figma file created by Owen: "launch-kit-apr22" https://figma.com/file/launchkit-apr22 node=5 (comments enabled).
Owen: Visual direction idea: left-aligned stat block + sparkline + small bar compare to baseline. GIF: simple count-up animation to the median stat. No heavy textures; use core palette.
Localization: Keep headline flexible for 70-80 char translations. Provide separate text layers for easy localization export. We'll need alt text in the asset manifest.
Legal: Reminder: avoid absolute claims like 'lowest' or 'fastest'. If we say 'lower cost' include supporting CSV in the asset package and a footnote: "See benchmark data". Link: https://legal.redwood/claims-guidance.pdf
Nina: I'll upload CSV and benchmark notes to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch_apr22.csv
Owen: Requesting exact CTA URL + UTM for the assets. Also confirm preferred file exports (PNG, 1200x675; 1080x1080; GIF 800x450; PPTX).
Priya: CTA: https://redwood.ai/webinar-apr22?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=launchkit_apr22. UTM param for inbound mapping: source=launch_apr22.
Ops: Inbound mapping: set source=launch_apr22. Route leads to queue "webinar-bench"; APAC => apac-sdr. Add hidden field "kit_variant". Confirmed.
Owen: Timeline: first drafts by Thu EOD, GIF prototype by Fri, final assets by Mon EOD for localization and legal sweep. Exports to /marketing-assets/launch_apr22.
Nina: Copy variants (short):
```
Variant 1: Predictable inference at scale. Join our Apr 22 webinar.
Variant 2: Ship LLM features with stable latency and lower inference costs. Register Apr 22.
Variant 3: Production-ready inference: consistent latency, clear economics. Live demo Apr 22.
```
Owen: I'll drop initial comps in Figma and tag folks. Accessibility note: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text, include alt text, and provide PPTX with editable text.
Legal: I'll review copy in Figma; send the CSV link in the asset package so claims have a clear source.
Localization: Once final copy is in Figma, we'll start translation. Please include a manifest CSV with string IDs.
Nina: Great — scheduling social posts for Apr 23 10:00 PT. @Owen please upload final exports to the marketing-assets folder after approvals. Thanks team! :rocket:
